svg.aria-label: Dawayar — The till keeps selling when the power doesn't. Stock by batch and expiry, a barcode till, purchases, customer and supplier credit and reports for Afghan pharmacies. Records live in the browser first; a small Worker syncs the devices when the line comes back.
